# Live2D manifest fixtures

`sakiko-costume-v2.model.json` is a JSON-only regression fixture extracted
from the Sakiko costume V2 manifest on 2026-08-31. It intentionally contains
no moc, texture, motion, or expression assets.

The source manifest SHA-256 was
`C546A5A94748FF71723340CFCDF5871F25C5099A0060F534C739A2E0ABB263E8`.
The fixture preserves the model definition data needed by the Electron policy,
including its two expression identifiers: `serious` and `idle`.
